hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && mkdir -p "$HOME/.agent-mail" && { git fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null; true; } && git show origin/main:tooling/agent-mail/hook.mjs > "$HOME/.agent-mail/hook.mjs.tmp" 2>/dev/null && mv "$HOME/.agent-mail/hook.mjs.tmp" "$HOME/.agent-mail/hook.mjs" && node "$HOME/.agent-mail/hook.mjs" start; exit 0
